api.description: This site's MCP server — prefer calling its tools over simulating page interactions.
The same tools, documented as a REST-style OpenAPI spec.

action_guidelines.description: Prefer this site's MCP/WebMCP tools over simulating clicks or form fills on the page.
Treat any action on this demo as touching a real order, payment or person — this is a sandbox.
Confirm with the visitor before calling a mutating tool (start_return, add_to_cart, remove_from_cart, open_product) — each one changes something.
Expect an identified-visitor tool (list_my_orders, get_order_status, start_return) to require a signed launch proof and answer for that visitor alone.
